title: To one who pronounces his love for you, for Allah's sake
arabic_title: الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله

duas.dua_english: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 4/333. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/965
duas.context: A supplication to make for someone who has expressed their love for you for the sake of Allah
